content: Black Friday is nearly over, but many of this year’s best deals are still available. You can still find some of the lowest prices we’ve seen in-store and online for video games, wireless earbuds, TVs, robot vacuums, and so much more. We can’t guarantee a deal you’ve had your eye on will last through Cyber Monday; however, if prior years are any indication, most will stick around through the long weekend. As usual, we sorted through thousands of deals to find the ones truly worth sharing, with an eye for the products and services we’ve tested here at The Verge. With prices up across multiple categories due to RAMageddon, some deals may not seem as big as in prior years. For example, Apple’s latest MacBook Air recently fell to its pre-price-hike level for the first time since July. That’s a deal to us, and several other discounts are still taking a similar shape, even as Black Friday winds down.
